name: Crater Tanks
summary: Pick your munition, find your arc and fire. Turn-based tank battles on destructible 3D battlefields, where every blast tears a real crater.
description: Crater Tanks is turn-based tank artillery in full 3D. Line up the shot, read the terrain and the radar, and land the hit, then watch the ground crater where your shell comes down.
Fight through a 20-mission story campaign, take on the Daily Challenge, pass one phone around, or go online for duels, team battles, a ranked ladder and a six-tank Battle Royale.

features.title: 158 weapons
features.text: Shells, cluster bombs, lasers, airstrikes and nukes, with terrain that craters where they land.

features.title: 39 tanks, each its own
features.text: Scouts, heavies, artillery, support and specialists, each with its own perks and signature ability. Upgrade them, fit modules and paint them your way.

features.title: A 20-mission campaign
features.text: Three chapters across farmland, a drowned coast and the glass desert, with a boss tank waiting at every chapter finale.

features.title: Procedural battlefields
features.text: A fresh battlefield every match across 11 biomes, with weather, day and night, deep water and lava.

features.title: Online duels and teams
features.text: Duel and Team Battle online, plus a ranked ladder that pairs commanders of similar power and rank.

features.title: Battle Royale
features.text: Six commanders, one battlefield, and a zone that closes in round after round.

features.title: Play at your pace
features.text: Async matches you can play whenever you have a minute, pass-and-play on one phone, or local Wi-Fi battles.

features.title: Fair play
features.text: Online you bring the tank, upgrades and research you've earned. No paid loot boxes.

data: Offline progress and settings stay on your phone. Online play uses a guest account (commander name, progress, scores); signing in with Google or Facebook is optional.
To delete your online account and everything linked to it, open Settings ▸ Delete account in the game, or email us.
Bought something that didn't arrive? Use Restore purchases in the game's Store. Refunds go through Google Play.
